newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The cabinet on Monday endorsed the draft Indemnity (Repeal) Act, 1996 to clear the way for trial of the killers of the independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has said the government will soon make schooling of girls free up to twelve class.
Some 182 Bangladeshis are languishing in different jails in Thailand.
About 600 people have been killed in road accidents from July to September this year, parliament was told on Monday.
Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad leaves for New Delhi on Friday in quest of a solution to the staggering Ganges water sharing problem with India.
The government plans to extend the railway in southern corridor to Myanmar under the proposed Trans Asian Railway, Communication Minister Anwar Hossain Manju said.
The cabinet on Monday decided to frame the country's fifth five-year plan (1997-98 to 2001-2002 financial year).
Bangladesh has discovered a new gas field in eastern Brahmanbaria district. Experts are now assessing the reserves in the field, the 20th in the country.
